name: A barber and customer, and other figure sketches
summary: An inked-in drawing of a barber attending to his customer, who is seated on the barber's triangular chest-cum-stool; with a detailed pencil drawing of the barber's hands on his client's head, and sketches of Macanese women and Chinese men.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
